title: OpenAI SDKs can generate and edit images
summary:
OpenAI-compatible image endpoints and three Pruna models landed, alongside smaller image sizes and repairs to image routing and API keys.

OpenAI-compatible image generation and edit endpoints were added, accepting prompts, source-image URLs or uploads. Responses can contain base64 data or an image URL. The OpenAI-compatible model list now includes permitted text, image and audio models; separate model-list pricing responses now use fixed-point strings, so clients need to handle those fields as strings.

Pruna adds `p-image` for generation, `p-image-edit` for edits and `p-video` for text- or image-to-video. Nanobanana-2 now selects an output-size tier from requested dimensions, and both Nanobanana-2 and Nanobanana Pro gained a 0.5K tier.

GPT Image edits now use the correct Azure endpoint and API version, with endpoint construction fixed for both `gptimage` and `gptimage-large`. Klein 4B provider requests were updated to reduce rejected requests; `klein-large` and its aliases were removed, while `klein` remains available.

highlights.title: Pruna image generation
highlights.text: Generate images with `p-image`. Requested dimensions map to the closest supported size. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=p-image).

highlights.title: Pruna image editing
highlights.text: Edit an input image with `p-image-edit`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=p-image-edit).

highlights.title: Pruna video generation
highlights.text: Make a video from text or an image with `p-video`, with a maximum duration of 10 seconds. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=p-video).

highlights.title: Smaller Nanobanana images
highlights.text: Choose the new 0.5K size tier with `nanobanana-2` or `nanobanana-pro` when a smaller image will do. [Browse Nanobanana-2](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana-2).

highlights.title: Images through OpenAI SDKs
highlights.text: Use OpenAI-compatible `/v1/images/generations` and `/v1/images/edits` endpoints to create images or edit source images from URLs or uploads. Get base64 data by default, or request an image URL. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Discover more models
highlights.text: Use `/v1/models` to find text, image and audio models available to your API key, including their modalities and supported endpoints. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
